steps.label: resume_disposable_preserved_minute7994_world

steps.label: compare_repaired_five_minute_wait
steps.objective: Verify world safe mode is OFF before movement. From saved turn 5231694 at [3157,3449,0], take exactly one ordinary native east step to [3158,3449,0], quicksave, confirm turn 5231695, then capture transition/native event file offsets and request exactly one native five-minute wait (300 turns). Capture exact turn delta and per-turn timing, wall elapsed, transition stream byte growth and counts for active_sortie_local_contact and production_signal_dispatch_admission grouped by outcome/reason, plus camp/member/dispatch/fire/inventory state after collection. Preserve changed rejections or renewed contact. Do not add fuel or setup; no injected events. Verify safe mode OFF after entry, any reload, or blocked movement. Stop after the one comparable wait and collect its evidence.
proof_targets: source/executable binding matches repaired readiness hashes
clone derives byte-for-byte from preserved minute-7994 source before documented single-field Tilda migration cancellation
safe mode OFF verified before movement/wait/reload
one east step and quicksave produce baseline start turn 5231695 and position [3158,3449,0]
one five-minute native wait advances exactly 300 turns
native per-turn timing and wall elapsed
transition stream offsets/bytes and both required transition event families counted by outcome/reason
camp, member, dispatch, burning brazier and inventory state at equal-workload checkpoints
invariants: use only the disposable cloned profile; source and active smoke profile remain untouched
no fixture install or world replacement
one east step reproduces original baseline start premise; do not step onto the brazier
safe mode must be OFF before movement or waiting and rechecked after reload or blocked movement
do not inject or author smoke, fire, light, signal, contact, camp, or dispatch
do not refuel or alter inventory/camp ecology unless an actually missing required premise is established
do not conflate simulation turn duration with wall time or event-file scan cost

evidence_contract.claim: The repaired current-source binary completes an equivalent 300-turn five-minute wait from the preserved minute-7994 camp/fire continuation while reducing duplicate contact and unchanged admission diagnostic writes and keeping native stream validation incremental.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Keep feature behavior and performance claims separate. Require exact source binding, exact 300-turn delta, comparable starting state, retained native turn timings, and transition-file/event counts for both event families; otherwise identify the first missing premise and report inconclusive.
